item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The diagram shows a number line from $6.0$ to $7.0$ with equal tenth marks. Lalit must place point $S$ at $6.8$.

One or more options may be correct. Which two claims correctly place $S$?

options.A: $S$ is the left endpoint $6.0$, so rename the target as that endpoint.
options.B: Count $8$ equal tenths from $6.0$ toward $7.0$, and put $S$ on that mark.
options.C: From $6.0$, move $0.8$ along the equal tenth scale, and put $S$ at $6.8$.
options.D: Put $S$ at the printed $7.0$, because $7$ is the standout digit near $6.8$.
